crossRefs.note: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”
translations.bsb: Then the scouts took two chariots with horses, and the king sent them after the Aramean army, saying, “Go and see.”
translations.kjv: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
translations.asv: They took therefore two chariots with horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
